note: Lane capabilities (2026-10-24): the slots of capabilities.html that drew the product in code show the system's own screens again — the four area cards of 四个板块，十四类能力 (tools/code-art-capareas.mjs placeAreaShots), the Sales Desk rows 01 and 03 (tools/blocks/qx-news.mjs), the quote band (tools/blocks/rk-stats.mjs), the creative portrait (tools/blocks/cn-faq.mjs) and the first card of 让 AI 团队把活干完 (tools/blocks/qx-projects.mjs). A slot keeps its box; the crop covers it from the top (css/stargo-real.css), so a crop is cut tall enough for the tallest box it meets at full width, and wider boxes show its top. Where the box turns from wide on a desktop to tall or square on an upright screen, a second, upright crop is cut (or, for the customer area, the phone capture of the same list). The Growth OS area card shows the published live05-growth-home-2x1 and live05-growth-home-start-5x4 as they are. The team area and the first crew card are cut from the published StaffDeck composites sw004 and sw006 (the digital-employee app was not captured on 2026-10-21, site-screens/mobile/NOTES.md), right of the sidebar so the upstream's mark stays out, and below the 298 headcount figure, which would argue with the card's 288 positions.
